summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias. Exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. The batch-coupling example was checked by hand (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333) but is not in the test module. A numpy float64 matrix will promote the loss to float64; I did not add a dtype cast because the spec did not ask for one.
